static_traits.name: 佳妮
static_traits.social_status: 家庭总体支持但not完全理解其夜班挑战；因夜班导致的疲惫与易怒使与家人朋友Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: without类似问题经历；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度Good，能Reflection并提出可行策略；语气中性，语速平稳

basic_info.main_problem: 我在酒店的夜班工作很难适应，导致持续的not适与not满；过去六个月压力逐渐升高，夜间工作时每晚都会出现负面情绪、挫败与not快乐，睡眠难以调整。
basic_info.core_demands: The persistent negative emotions and stress brought by night shifts affect overall health and the ability to 'save money for university', therefore I hope through counseling to relieve stress, adjust sleep, improve night-shift adaptation and mindset; at the same time I try recording positive moments, maintaining a more consistent sleep rhythm, and communicating with family for support.

core_beliefs: 我可能not够胜任这份工作

special_situations.event: At midnight while working the hotel night shift, energy is lowest and fatigue worsens
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我一直适应not了夜班，就说明我not行、这份工作not适合我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在值班时听音乐、做短暂休息来缓解not适
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能永远适应not了这份夜班

special_situations.event: Realizes others have a more 'normal' daytime schedule while she has to work night shifts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的作息not如do not人正常，就说明我的处境not公平、I am not as good as others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Complains and compares, reduces focus on the positive side, and argues with family
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 为什么只有我得上这些时间的班？这not公平

special_situations.event: 工作中出现小失误或Decreased attention
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我有疏漏，就意味着我工作not够好，可能会丢掉工作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-criticism and executes tasks tensely in order to avoid mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我做得not好，迟早会丢掉工作

special_situations.event: Positive experiences occur during shifts (such as positive interactions with guests, quieter nighttime atmosphere)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 偶尔的正面体验并not能代表整体变好，not能说明我适应得更好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or downplays positive segments; focuses only on the negative
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些好的时刻not算数，整体还是很糟

core_conflict.wish: Longs to have a stable routine, feel competent at work, and be understood and supported by family
core_conflict.fear: 害怕长期without法适应夜班而失去工作、身心耗竭，并使Family relationships进一步恶化
defense_goal: 通过理性解释与自我控制来降低Anxiety并维持基本稳定
Reduces conflict to protect important relationships and job position

object_relations.self_representation: A tired and irritable worker who needs understanding and support
object_relations.object_representation: 支持但not完全理解其困境的家人

object_relations.self_representation: A server who can deliver value in positive interactions

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当家人not yet能理解夜班的困难或对其情绪反应提出质疑时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为家人忽视自己的辛苦与需求，像外界一样要求自己“像do not人一样”作息
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: useEmpathy且具体的语言，先承认其感受，再邀请其描述当下最困难的部分与可控的微小改变；语气温和、避免评判。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当午夜疲惫、出现工作小失误并Self-denial时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将外在压力与可能的负面结果内化为“I am not good enough”的评价
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 温和放慢节奏，邀请其区分事实与评价；use具体化与正常化技术，鼓励其给自己设定可达成的微目标与自我安抚练习。

manifestations: 对排班与作息缺乏自主感，感到“not公平”与受限
难以调整昼夜节律，对夜班安排without力感
outcomes: Declining sleep quality与整体幸福感受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly focuses on mistakes and performance decline at work
Frequently worries about 'possibly losing the job'
Concentrates attention more on negative experiences and ignores positive interactions

exception_events.target_problem: 在夜班工作至午夜时，来访者通常会出现强烈负面想法与情绪，Decreased attention、对小事更易烦躁，进而影响工作表现
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某些夜晚（比如not那么疲惫或与客人有积极互动时），她感到更可控、心情更好、专注度提升，have not陷入以往的负性螺旋，工作表现更稳定
exception_events.reason: not同情境：疲劳程度较低；关系not同：与客人发生积极互动；环境特点：夜间较安静的氛围被感知为正面线索，因此更容易关注到工作的价值与正面体验

positive_force: 能自我Reflection并愿意尝试记录积极时刻
Willing to adjust sleep rhythm and actively seek support
Able to notice positive value in work (interacting with guests, quiet nights)
negative_force: 心理过滤与negate积极的认知模式
对失误过度概括与对not yet来的负向预测
Persistent fatigue and irritability caused by circadian rhythm disruption
Tense family relationships from exhaustion and arguments

target_behavior.behavior: Irritability and concentration difficulties during night shifts (with increased negative automatic thoughts)
antecedent: Hotel night-shift work, especially near the midnight hours
Sleep rhythm hard to adjust; persistent fatigue
When comparing routines with others or thinking of possibly losing the job
target_behavior.core_reason: 对夜班的长期适应困难与昼夜节律失调；产生“我not行/可能会丢工作”的自动化思维与比较的not公平感，Reinforcement负面情绪与注意力受损
target_behavior.function: Briefly escapes high-load demands and vents tense and tired emotions, trying to gain a sense of control through self-criticism and vigilance
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、错误增多；与家人争吵导致Relationship tension；睡眠质量与整体幸福感进一步受损
